title: Golden fixture: unknown optional fields
body: This payload is at the current payload_schema_version (1), so RecordPayload::from_json must accept it -- but it also carries two fields (future_priority_flag, future_reminder) that no field on Note names. A read-then-write round trip through this build must reproduce both unrecognized fields byte-for-byte via Note's own #[serde(flatten)] unknown map, exactly as a real future minor payload addition would need to survive an older build.
